description: Defines two Flutter stateless widgets, DividerListTile and DividerListTileWithTrilingText, which are custom list tile components with optional icons, trailing text, and dividers for use in a Flutter UI.

classes.name: DividerListTile
classes.description: A custom ListTile widget with optional leading icon, trailing arrow, and optional bottom divider.

classes.name: DividerListTileWithTrilingText
classes.description: A similar widget that includes an SVG icon, title, trailing text, and optional arrow indicator.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for each custom list tile.
